description: An elegant and formal living room corner rendered in a muted cool-grey palette with restrained Parisian sensibility. The wall behind the sofa is finished in smooth light grey plaster or paint and features deeply recessed applied panel molding in a classical grid pattern — two large rectangular panels visible, their reveals casting subtle shadow lines that add architectural depth without color. Floor-to-ceiling charcoal-grey velvet drapery panel hangs at the right edge of the frame, its heavy texture absorbing light and anchoring the composition with depth and drama. A cream linen sofa with tight cushions and a squared, modern silhouette anchors the foreground; two large matte-black velvet square throw pillows are stacked against the back cushions, providing sharp tonal contrast. To the right of the sofa, a small round side table with a white Carrara marble top and a matte black pedestal base holds a clear glass vase filled with loose white cherry blossom stems, a small white ceramic candle vessel, and a tiny dark cup. The floor is warm honey-toned hardwood, barely visible at the frame edge. A small warm glow emanates from a wall position centered on the paneled wall, casting a soft amber pool downward onto the sofa back. The overall mood is quiet and formal: grey, cream, black, and white with no overt accent colors. Camera is at standing eye-level, framing a three-quarter view into the living room corner, showing the full wall panel height, the sofa front, and the side table at right.
